name: Edge Studio
description: Edge Studio is an AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) agency and AI visibility tools company based in Australia. We help ecommerce brands, DTC founders, service businesses, and natural health practitioners get recommended by AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Edge Studio developed The Eligibility Layer — the framework that identified AI recommendation eligibility as a distinct and prior challenge to AI ranking.
slogan: AEO Agency for the AI Search Era

founder.name: Marina
founder.description: Marina is the founder of Edge Studio. She has 10 plus years of experience in content strategy, digital marketing, and brand positioning, combined with deep expertise in AI visibility, automation, and structured data. She is a qualified natural health practitioner with specialist experience in the natural health and wellness industry. Marina coined The Eligibility Layer framework — the concept that AI recommendation systems apply a binary trust threshold before any ranking occurs.

subjectOf.name: The Eligibility Layer
subjectOf.description: A framework developed by Marina of Edge Studio that identifies AI recommendation eligibility as a distinct and prior challenge to AI ranking. The Eligibility Layer is the binary trust threshold an entity must pass before an agent system will consider recommending it. Brands outside the eligibility layer are not ranked lower — they are not mentioned at all.

subjectOf.name: Australian Brand AI Visibility Leaderboard
subjectOf.description: Australia's first monthly AI visibility leaderboard. Tests 30 Australian consumer brands across 5 categories using 10 organic purchase-intent prompts per brand across ChatGPT and Claude. Scores brands out of 100 per engine based on whether they appear in AI recommendations. Published monthly by Edge Studio.

itemOffered.name: Found By AI
itemOffered.description: An automated AI visibility audit tool. Found By AI runs 20 purchase-intent prompts across major AI platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. It scores brand visibility out of 20 and generates 6 content assets to improve AI visibility. Results are delivered by email in under 60 minutes. Works for both product brands and service businesses.

itemOffered.name: AI Visibility Foundation
itemOffered.description: A fixed-scope AEO engagement covering entity definition, category positioning, WAVE framework entity page brief, and external authority strategy. Designed to move a brand from outside the AI candidate set to inside it.

itemOffered.name: AEO Retainer
itemOffered.description: Monthly AEO retainer for ongoing AI visibility strategy, entity clarity, schema briefing, and distribution coordination. Edge Studio acts as embedded AEO director.

itemOffered.name: Sage
itemOffered.description: A 24/7 AI-powered patient guidance chatbot for clinics and natural health practitioners. Currently in development.

brand.name: Edge Studio
brand.description: Edge Studio is a specialist AEO agency and AI visibility tools company. The brand is known for the Found By AI audit tool, The Eligibility Layer framework, the Australian Brand AI Visibility Leaderboard, and done-for-you AEO services for ecommerce and wellness brands.
